pit_internal_log

Stores internal PIT message in case of non reportable, internal errors.

Fields
pil_log_id

ID of the message, auto generated

pil_log_date

Log date the message, auto generated

pil_msg_text

Text of the message

pil_msg_stack

Callstack

pil_msg_backtrace

Backtrace

pil_affected_id

Internal reference, for example name of an output module
